me.join.statement: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO members(user_id, display, role, joined_at) VALUES(?1, ?2, 'member', ?3)

me.get.statement: SELECT user_id, display, role FROM members WHERE user_id = ?1 LIMIT 1

members.list.statement: SELECT display, role, joined_at FROM members ORDER BY joined_at LIMIT 200

members.promote.statement: UPDATE members SET role = 'admin' WHERE display = ?1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members a WHERE a.user_id = ?2 AND a.role = 'admin')

cards.list.statement: SELECT c.id, c.title, c.status, c.owner_id, m.display AS owner FROM cards c LEFT JOIN members m ON m.user_id = c.owner_id ORDER BY c.created_at LIMIT 500

cards.create.statement: INSERT INTO cards(title, status, owner_id, created_at) SELECT ?1, 'todo', ?2, ?3 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?2)

cards.move.statement: UPDATE cards SET status = ?1 WHERE id = ?2 AND ?1 IN ('todo','doing','done') AND (owner_id = ?3 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?3 AND role = 'admin'))

cards.delete.statement: DELETE FROM cards WHERE id = ?1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?2 AND role = 'admin')
